stem: A runoff EC result is entered without identifying that the sample was runoff. What is the main data-quality problem?
choices: Runoff never needs an EC value
The measurement method/sample type is missing, so the value can be misinterpreted or compared incorrectly
rationale: The measurement method/sample type is missing, so the value can be misinterpreted or compared incorrectly. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
